integrity: General proof is symbolic. Finite-field enumeration supports only tested cases. Earlier split-field tree classification and conjectural split-count expression are credited; review is not independent.
scientific_limitations: Only idempotent weight-minus-one splitting operators on nonzero finite étale finite-field algebras; excludes non-idempotent and weight-zero operators, non-étale rings and automorphism-conjugacy counts. No exhaustive bibliographic priority claim.
title: Frobenius tree formula for splitting Rota–Baxter projections on finite étale algebras
